description.en: Five downward-tapering stalactites hang from an irregular ceiling patch, with one longer offset pendant and four shorter ones. The origin is the upper ceiling attachment, not the floor. A generic stylized calcite form, not a whole cave or a named-site, age or measured-scale reconstruction.
description.zh: 五根向下渐细的钟乳石悬挂于不规则洞顶片：一根较长且偏置，其余四根较短。原点位于洞顶上方附着点，而非地面。属于通用风格化方解石形态，并非整座洞穴或特定地点、年代、实测尺度的复原。
